main.summary: SignalR-backed notification client that maintains persistent follow-session subscriptions and coalescing wake latches over a shared SignalR connection.

field.name: gate
field.summary: Serializes connection lifecycle and persistent registration state mutations.

field.name: certificate
field.summary: Client certificate used when connecting to the notification hub.

field.name: endpoint
field.summary: Base service endpoint used to construct the SignalR hub URI.

field.name: connection
field.summary: Current SignalR hub connection used for notification subscriptions.

field.name: currentToken
field.summary: Current bearer token supplied to the SignalR access token provider.

field.name: registrations
field.summary: Persistent registration registry keyed by normalized logical subscription identity.

field.name: ConnectionClosedWhileWaiting
field.summary: Exception used to fail an in-flight wait when the SignalR connection closes.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a SignalR-backed notification client for the given endpoint and certificate.
constructor.param: Client certificate used for the SignalR connection.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously release the SignalR connection and fail all active registration waiters.
method.returns: A value task that completes when the connection and synchronization resources have been released.

method.name: RegisterSubscriptionAsync
method.summary: Register a persistent logical follow-session subscription and return a lifetime-owned wait handle.
method.returns: A task that completes with a persistent wait handle for the normalized logical subscription.

method.name: WaitForRegistrationWakeAsync
method.summary: Wait for the next coalesced wake signal associated with a persistent registration handle.
method.param: Persistent registration handle whose observed signal version is being advanced.
Wait duration for the wake operation. Must be positive or .
method.returns: A task that completes with true when a new wake signal is observed; otherwise false when the wait elapses without a wake.

method.name: UnregisterAsync
method.summary: Release a persistent registration handle and remove its hub subscriptions when the final reference is disposed.
method.returns: A task that completes when the registration has been released.

method.name: OnNotificationReceived
method.summary: Route a received notification across all matching persistent registrations and advance their wake latches.
method.returns: A task that completes when all matching registrations have been signaled.

method.name: FailActiveWaiters
method.summary: Fail all active registration waiters with the supplied connection-lifecycle exception.
method.param: Failure to propagate to active waiters.

method.name: Matches
method.summary: Determine whether a received notification satisfies the requested logical subscription.
method.returns: True when the notification matches the subscription; otherwise false.

method.name: EnsureConnectedAsync
method.summary: Ensure the SignalR connection exists and is started before persistent registrations subscribe to hub topics.
method.returns: A task that completes when the hub connection is ready.

method.name: CreateConnection
method.summary: Create the SignalR hub connection configured for certificate authentication, bearer token forwarding, and automatic reconnect.
method.returns: A configured hub connection for DataControl notifications.

method.name: SubscribeAsync
method.summary: Subscribe the shared SignalR connection to the logical topics represented by the supplied subscription.
method.returns: A task that completes when all requested topic subscriptions are registered.

method.name: UnsubscribeAsync
method.summary: Remove the shared SignalR connection from the logical topics represented by the supplied subscription.
method.returns: A task that completes when all requested topic removals are sent.

method.name: ValidateSubscription
method.summary: Validate that a logical notification subscription contains at least one usable identifier.

method.name: CreateKey
method.summary: Normalize a logical notification subscription into a stable registry key.
method.returns: Stable normalized key representing the logical subscription identity.

method.name: CreateWaiter
method.summary: Create a new asynchronous latch waiter for a persistent registration.
method.returns: A waiter completion source configured for asynchronous continuations.

method.name: SetToken
method.summary: Update the bearer token used by the SignalR access token provider for subsequent hub operations.

main.summary: Represents the shared registration state for a normalized persistent notification subscription.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create registration state for a logical notification subscription.
constructor.param: Logical notification subscription represented by the registration.

property.name: LastNotification
property.summary: Gets or sets the last notification routed through the registration.

property.name: ReferenceCount
property.summary: Gets or sets the number of active handles currently referencing the registration.

property.name: SignalVersion
property.summary: Gets or sets the monotonically increasing wake-signal version for the registration.

property.name: Subscription
property.summary: Gets the logical notification subscription represented by the registration.

property.name: Waiter
property.summary: Gets or sets the current coalescing waiter latch for the registration.

main.summary: Represents a lifetime-owned persistent notification subscription handle backed by a shared coalescing wake latch.

field.name: owner
field.summary: Owns the shared SignalR registration registry and wake logic.

field.name: disposed
field.summary: Tracks whether the handle has already been released.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a persistent subscription handle for a normalized registration key.
constructor.param: Initial observed signal version captured at registration time.

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the handle has been released.

property.name: Key
property.summary: Gets the normalized registration key owned by the handle.

property.name: ObservedSignalVersion
property.summary: Gets or sets the latest wake-signal version observed by the handle.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Release the persistent registration handle and unregister it from the shared registry.
method.returns: A value task that completes when the handle has been unregistered.

method.name: WaitForWakeAsync
method.summary: Wait for the next coalesced wake signal on this persistent subscription handle.
method.param: Wait duration to apply to the wake operation.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when a new wake signal is observed; otherwise false when the wait elapses without a wake.
